entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-08-20
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • CA1860 should be reported for derived types as well #50398
  • restore operations using dotnet 10 sdk result in ssl errors #50396
  • `main` is now .NET 11, use `release/10.0.1xx` for .NET 10 work! #50394
    11.0.1xx
  • Different files in dotnet-sdk-10.0.100-rc.1.25419.111-win-x64.zip vs dotnet-sdk-10.0.100-rc.1.25419.111-win-x64.exe #50390
  • `dotnet completions script pwsh` is very different from https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/core/tools/enable-tab-autocomplete#powershell #50387

Closed

  • Build issue with 8.0.x / possibly DOTNET9 / 10 of msbuild - Could not find a part of the path on linux #50385
  • The `any` RID fallback for framework dependent, RID-agnostic tools does not include all required assets #50312
    10.0.1xx
  • `dotnet test -?` (MTP) output should be sorted by option name #50349

PullRequests

Created

  • detect .NET 10 RID-specific tools and provide a more actionable error #50399
    Servicing-consider, Branch Lockdown
  • CA1860 should be reported for derived types as well (analyzer fix with performance improvements) #50397
  • Fix some error messages in dotnet test #50393
  • Recreate code in https://github.com/dotnet/roslyn-analyzers/pull/7382 #50392
    Area-Infrastructure
  • initiall attempt at #12120 #50389
  • Edit to trigger a build to compare the test results #50386

Merged

  • Action for main dotnet 11 warning #50395
  • Fix package prune data for .NET Core 2.x #50370
  • Simplify run properties usage #50391
  • Consolidate default verbosity of msbuild-based commands #50243
    Area-run-file
  • Allow `any`-RID builds to resolve assets like completely-RID-less builds #50376
    Area-Tools, 10.0.1xx
  • Fix ProductName for SDK placeholder #50378
  • Sort options alphabetically by name #50363
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Default `dotnet new sln` to slnx format for .NET 10 #50373
  • Add initial installer interfaces for dnup #50379
  • Generate pruning data correctly (#50348) #50377

Updated

  • Support CsWinRT 3.0 multi-targeting and WindowsSdkPackageMinimumRevision #50264
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Update to the September implicit version #50344
  • Update the minimum msbuild version for .NET 10 #49531
  • Prepare delta applier for code sharing #49974
    Area-AspNetCore
  • Add suppressor support for `dotnet format` #48512
    untriaged, Area-Format
  • Fix CA1859 improperly handling default interface implementations #50314
  • Fix updating `globaljsonworkloadsets.json` #50372
    Area-Workloads
  • Unskip test cases #50010
  • Suggested perf improvements in DataFlowAnalysis #50310
  • Add PostAction for dotnet.config #50285
    Area-Infrastructure
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0.1xx' => 'main' #50371
  • [dotnet-format] Include the .NET Framework buildhost executable in the SDK. #48969
    Branch Lockdown
  • [release/8.0.1xx] Use new ACR for registry image #49691
    Area-Containers, Branch Lockdown
  • [release/9.0.3xx] [StaticWebAssets] Additional endpoints were incorrectly being passed to consuming projects #50172
    Branch Lockdown
  • Make duplicate deb/rpm packages so we can sign them with the new PMC key #50294
    Servicing-consider, Area-Infrastructure, Branch Lockdown
  • Add activity spans for template creation and most tool usage #50163
    Area-Telemetry
